name: smartschedule-ai-monorepo
description: SmartSchedule AI - Hệ Thống Quản Lý & Đặt Lịch Nha Khoa Đa Chi Nhánh

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND,AI-SERVICE" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.dev:zalo: concurrently -n "BACKEND,AI,ZALO-TUNNEL" -c "green.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run tunnel:zalo"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND,AI,ZALO-TUNNEL" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run tunnel:zalo"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
